# Bisnouli Sarvodaya Gramodyog Sewa Sansthan (BSGSS)

> Official website: https://www.bsgssindia.org
> Registered voluntary non-profit organisation advancing community-led rural development, healthcare, education, and women's empowerment across North India since 1994.

## Key Institutional Facts
- **Full Name**: Bisnouli Sarvodaya Gramodyog Sewa Sansthan (BSGSS)
- **Founded**: 15 June 1994
- **Society Registration No.**: 226/1994-95 (Societies Registration Act XXI of 1860)
- **MCA CSR-1 Registration No.**: CSR00001405 (Eligible for Schedule VII CSR partnerships)
- **NITI Aayog NGO Darpan ID**: DL/2016/0111645
- **Tax Exemptions**: Section 12A & Section 80G (Income Tax Act, 1961)
- **Patron**: Vijay Kumar Jha (Ex-IPS)
- **Chief Executive Officer (CEO)**: Nandita Bakshi (Ex-IRS)

## Verified Grassroots Impact (1994–Present)
- **Total Beneficiaries Reached**: 50 Lac+ (5,000,000+)
- **Medical Patients Treated**: 20 Lac+ (2,000,000+) through mobile clinics, cancer screening vans, and eye/health camps
- **Women Empowered**: 36,000+ rural women through Self-Help Groups (SHGs), AMAR micro-finance, and vocational training
- **Villages Reached**: 350+ villages
- **CSR & Institutional Partners**: 35+ PSU and corporate partners (including ONGC, Indian Oil, NTPC, PowerGrid, REC, PFC, GAIL, NHPC, BHEL, HUDCO, NBCC, and more)
- **Active Footprint (7 States)**: Delhi NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand
- **Fund Efficiency Standard**: 88% direct grassroots programmes, 7% field operations & auditing, 5% statutory & administrative compliance

## Core Programmes
- **Preventive Healthcare & Mobile Medical Units**: Free diagnostic camps, mobile cancer screening, eye check-ups, maternal & adolescent health, and medicine distribution.
- **Women's Empowerment & Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**: Village SHGs, AMAR micro-finance, tailoring/embroidery training, and handcrafted textile production (shawls, stoles, Madhubani sarees, jute bags, cushion covers).
- **Skill Development & Vocational Training**: Certified tailoring, computer literacy, beauty culture, and entrepreneurship training.
- **Rural Education**: Community learning centres, digital literacy, and school support.
